inputs.checklistItemText: Tree clearances measured from utility pole centerline or structure instead of from outer electric conductor
inputs.question: Are any dimension lines or clearance measurements shown between proposed trees and the overhead electric line on the landscape plan? If dimensions are shown, do they measure from the tree trunk center or from the outer conductor position?
inputs.regionHint: along the southern boundary where the overhead electric line and proposed trees are shown together

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether dimension lines/measurements exist on the plan and what reference point they use (tree center vs. outer conductor). This is a presence-and-label-readout question, not a measurement task. The actual clearance measurement between tree and conductor would come later if dimensions are found to be incorrect.
